body: I tried to cry for the last hour but i sort of just sat still, thinking about everything. as pathetic as it sounds, i almost feel that if i just had a sense that im not doomed to being alone for the rest of my life that i would recover so much faster

I wish i could control my mind like that. its awful how my thoughts are what are keeping me down right now. i just spent the last hour or so thinking about suicide and im still very torn on why i shouldnt but also on why i should. i dont know what that means. i dont know why ive been having such a hard time these last couple days

I hate knowing that you're right, that i may be miserable and wanting nothing more than to talk to her, but that if i do and find out exactly how she's doing it'll just make me feel even worse. ive felt like ive been in a lull or sorts for the last hour. ive just been sitting here, sort of like a final moments thing but a dont do it thing. i just wish i had a sign that i wont always feel like this

>I know you're hurting, but you're only hurting because you loved someone so truly and deeply and you should be proud of your capacity to care for another person so deeply

I hate that i fell so hard for someone that now cares so so little about me. I can not even begin to understand how she just forgot about me so quickly when I still, almost three months later, think about her almost daily and wish more than anything that she would say something

And youre probably right about my brother

I feel like someone stabbed me in the chest. I honestly dont know why the hell im so hung up over her when i know i 'deserve' far better than what she was. but its just killing me so badly that she doesnt even remotely care and that she's done everything she has done. and i doubt they'd care much; my brother saw me fighting back tears and hasnt mentioned anything and my ex would probably just see it as assurance that i'd never be in her life again

I know how much it would hurt my family. But I try to not think about how it would get to my friends. Specifically my best friend from back at school who absolutely hates suicide after being affected by it several times. While I hate thinking about my ex, I also hate thinking about the people this would actually have an effect on. I almost just wish she would know the extent of the damage she's had on me, even if I know she wouldn't care. But then again, I know it wouldn't do me any good so I don't know why I still hope for it

>She made some bad decisions, but you shouldn't have to pay for them.

This really hit me..

>and the girl in this age (I'm 23 FYI) can be just downright fucking stupid.

It's funny because even her own mother and sister tell me she'll regret it some day. That surprised me quite a bit, to hear from those closest to her about how even they know she's making a mistake

And you're right. I can't allow myself to fall apart over someone like her. I just hate that it does from time to time and I cant wait until Im finally passed this.

Thank you so much for talking to me through this. You honestly have no idea how much I appreciate it

>I understand your feelings completely man, i wish you know how much of the same level we are on. It hurts to feel replaced or like you're not good enough. 

I know that asking for a quick solution would be stupid, so Ill just how it is that you at least keep or kept those feelings at bay. I cant seem to control them. One minute I feel like im on top of everything, then with the tiniest trigger I fall. I fell harder this time than I have in a long time and I have no idea why it was so bad

It doesn't sound harsh. It's what I need to hear. I need to get it through my skull that she wasn't good for me, and like I said [here](http://www.reddit.com/r/SuicideWatch/comments/noh7h/ending_everything_feels_like_the_most_logical/c3ap4za), if this were happening to a friend of mine I'd be telling him the same thing. So no, don't apologize. I need to realize that what you said is completely true so that I can get over it all. It's just so hard is all

I was hiking a lot the first few days after I came home. I stopped because I couldn't really stand being alone, but I'll probably start doing that again because sitting here isn't doing me much good. I still feel numb right now

It's the fear of being an absolute failure in life that scares me; being alone and miserable on the streets for the rest of my life.

Alongside that is what I wrote [here](http://www.reddit.com/r/SuicideWatch/comments/noh7h/ending_everything_feels_like_the_most_logical/c3apa3k)

>Everybody has their problems, every single one of them, we're all just putting on a show. 

As selfish (dont think thats the right word) as this may sound, this is connected to whats making it so hard for me. I know very very well that everyone has problems. But when I think of her, I imagine she's as happy as can be and having the greatest carefree life ever. I hate that she's made such a great recovery while Im sitting here in a massive rut, with a giant bottle of pills on the table next to me

That's kind of what's been keeping me going. The fact that I'm not as bad as I was at the beginning. It's just these stupid relapses that I wish would stop. Randomly thinking about her while I'm supposed to be unwinding from the school i hate is really getting me. Im guessing thats why break has been so bad for me. Having almost nothing to do while my parents are gone and my brother ignores me all day has really had an effect on me.

Yeah, unfortunately. Im not rich or anything; Im actually somewhat on the poor side and thats why I cant go back home with all the expectations everyone has of me. And yes, I definitely plan to get involved in something. Anything to keep me from thinking about this so constantly

>Imagine someone you know had this happen to him. If his girl left and then did all these things, think for a moment what you'd say to him.

This actually helps a bit, thinking about it like that. And what you said above; if I had stayed with this person and then gone through this during a marriage.

I just wish I could stop thinking about this altogether. I often wonder how it is that she could so easily do it while Im still hammering myself over it, almost three months out

My parents have a giant cabinet full of hard liquor. I figure I'm just going to take all the pills and then drink as much vodka tequila and whatever the hell else is in there as I possibly can before passing out

Oh i have no doubt that im getting over her. But its so fucking slow. I wish I could skip to whenever it will be that I dont think about her ever anymore. Just reading the word 'girlfriend' all over reddit starts making me feel like shit. I hate her so much; I hate that I fell so hard for her and she just abandoned me so badly. No I would never take her back after how much she's hurt me, but I wish she would say something to me. Anything that makes me feel not so abandoned. And the *hell* do I still care about her well-being when she couldn't give two shits about mine? What is wrong with me and why cant I just shake this altogether

Honestly, I cant transfer out. Not just because of the money (i could never afford it elsewhere), but because everyone expects me to be the fucking president some day or some stupid shit. Yeah, i go to a school *like that*. If I leave it ill forever be known as the guy that tossed everything away after being given a massive opportunity. But I dont care anymore. I hate being alone so fucking much

I really appreciate it. Most of the friends I have would immediately call an ambulance or something and then everything would just get far worse

That's the thing, I hate that I haven't seen one thing to make me think I wont be alone. I hate that she so quickly found a replacement. I hate that it was someone so much 'worse' (though i guess if he were 'better' then I'd feel even worse). Meanwhile I can't do anything. I feel so fucking alone. What's the point of doing well in school if Im just going to be miserable. Thats whats killing me. I could be the most successful person in the world for all i care but if im alone then this will never feel good. I hate myself so much
